correctness.rationale: Reconstructed edge-to-edge line distance as 1+minimum endpoint Hamming distance (off-diagonal); Walsh edge-axis sectors give diagonal F_(n-1)(s,p)-1 and off-diagonal 2 F_(n-2)(s,p). For 0<p<1 Bernstein integral J proves negative all axial/nonprincipal transverse modes; only axis-constant zero-sum multiplicity n-1 has eigenvalue S_n(p)-1. S_n increases from 0 to 2^(n-2); n=2 boundary p=1 handled separately. Centered Schoenberg Gram rank gives n2^(n-1)-n at endpoint; binomial B_n∼2^(n-1)/n and p B_n≤S_n(p)≤p n^p B_n yield p_n∼n/2^(n-1). Independently compared direct BFS cube-edge powered-distance spectra to sector eigenvalues for n=2..4 at distinct powers; no inference for infinite n from finite eigenvalues.
